channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: New York State Museum begins $150m modernisation project
item.description: A new era of exhibitions and infrastructure upgrades is coming to the oldest and largest state museum in the US

item.title: Claims of 8,000-year-old petroglyph’s discovery in Venezuela raise questions about scientific rigour and Indigenous custodianship
item.description: While local officials hailed the petroglyph as the potential linchpin of a heritage tourism to the region, archaeologists point to a lack of thorough analysis

item.title: New and relaunched satellite fairs spread across Los Angeles during Frieze
item.description: With lower costs than the main event, and in some cases models that are centred on artists, these smaller events seek to offer an enticing alternative to the blue-chip global fairs

item.title: Rose Wylie: ‘It’s very, very fragile where a painting ends. All the time it sits on a precarious edge’
item.description: After beginning her career in the 1950s, and then taking 25 years out to raise a family, the artist finally hit her stride in the 2000s. Now, she is the first female painter to have a show in the main galleries of the Royal Academy of Arts in London

item.title: Venice exhibition of US artist Hernan Bas will tackle issue of mass tourism
item.description: “The Visitors” includes more than 30 new paintings of youths who represent “cliches of the contemporary tourist”

item.title: Ukraine adopts resolution to aid evacuation of artefacts from front line
item.description: The government's decision to simplify the process of removing millions of objects in high-risk zones comes as the war with Russia enters its fifth year

item.title: Comment | Time for a rethink: women artists were never meant to merely be canon fodder
item.description: Exhibitions pairing Munch with Paula Modersohn-Becker and Maria Lassnig provide opportunities to subvert the established order

item.title: Museum of Contemporary Art Los Angeles acquires Kara Walker sculpture made from dissected Confederate monument
item.description: Walker’s “Unmanned Drone” is a centrepiece of “Monuments”, a landmark exhibition at Moca and The Brick

item.title: Louvre director Laurence des Cars resigns in wake of heist and ticketing scandal
item.description: Des Cars had pursued a costly renovation and expansion plan even as staff went on strike to advocate for tackling more urgent issues

item.title: End of the line for Bergamot Station, Santa Monica’s arts hub?
item.description: The city is eyeing the site, home since 1994 to more than a dozen galleries and arts nonprofits, as a possible location for state-mandated housing development
